meta.description_1l: Local durable collaboration router for Codex, Grok, and Claude Code agents.
meta.description_short: Agent Collab is a local TypeScript CLI and stdio MCP control plane backed by SQLite. It owns provider routing, durable workflow and graph state, review barriers, approvals, worktree leases, history indexing, recovery, migration, and evidence-gated evaluation.

architecture_fidelity.truth_model: evidence-ranked approximation; not a complete runtime call graph
architecture_fidelity.enrichment_model: final deterministic pass over production code evidence and first-party tests
architecture_fidelity.tool_orchestration_model: repo-c4-scan auto-runs ast-index and ast-code-graph when available

confidence_scale.high: direct first-party import or inheritance resolved to an existing file
confidence_scale.medium: unique first-party symbol reference resolved to an existing file
confidence_scale.low: heuristic relationship that needs human confirmation

blind_spots: plugin loading discovered only at runtime
remote service behavior outside this repository
generated or vendored code intentionally excluded

tool_orchestration.strategy: repo-c4-scan orchestrates ast-index and ast-code-graph as optional evidence providers

system.name: Agent Collab
system.description: Local single-user collaboration control plane for coding agents, exposed through a CLI and stdio MCP server.

users.name: Local Operator
users.description: Starts workflows, grants bounded authority, inspects durable state, runs migrations, and reconciles ambiguous attempts

users.name: Coding Agent Client
users.description: Uses stdio MCP tools to delegate bounded work, request reviews, and query durable results

system.top_boundary: Local CLI and stdio MCP control plane with private SQLite state; provider CLIs are external execution adapters.

containers.name: Agent Collab
containers.description: Local process boundary hosting CLI commands, the stdio MCP server, durable routing and review orchestration, and offline SQLite migration tools.
responsibilities: Route bounded work across Codex and optional helper providers
Persist workflow, review, graph, approval, lease, and evidence state
Expose local CLI and stdio MCP control surfaces
Enforce provider health, authority, recovery, and production quarantine
Run guarded offline schema migrations and restore procedures
